name: event_history_count
description: Number of recent squad appearances with observed event statistics.
computation: Count available event-stat records among the last ten eligible matches.
availability_rule: Both event_time and available_at must precede prediction_cutoff.
null_strategy: Zero means no observed event history, never zero performance.

name: player_age_years
description: Player age at the prediction cutoff.
computation: Years between date_of_birth and prediction_cutoff.
availability_rule: Date of birth record available_at must not exceed prediction_cutoff.

name: new_transfer_flag
description: Whether the player joined the club in the previous 60 days.
computation: valid_from is within 60 days before cutoff.
availability_rule: Transfer must be announced and available before prediction_cutoff.
null_strategy: False only when roster history is complete; otherwise missing indicator.

name: recent_injury_return_flag
description: Recent return from an injury spell.
computation: Latest ended injury is within 30 days of cutoff.
availability_rule: Only injury status updates available before prediction_cutoff.

name: suspension_active
description: Known active suspension for the fixture.
computation: Fixture date falls within a suspension known by cutoff.
availability_rule: Suspension available_at must not exceed prediction_cutoff.
null_strategy: Unknown if source is stale; otherwise false.

name: minutes_last_1
description: Minutes in the most recent eligible appearance.
computation: Sum minutes over recency rank 1.
availability_rule: event_time and available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: minutes_last_3
description: Minutes over the three most recent eligible appearances.
computation: Sum minutes over recency ranks 1 through 3.
availability_rule: event_time and available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: minutes_last_5
description: Minutes over the five most recent eligible appearances.
computation: Sum minutes over recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: event_time and available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: minutes_last_10
description: Minutes over the ten most recent eligible appearances.
computation: Sum minutes over recency ranks 1 through 10.
availability_rule: event_time and available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: starts_last_5
description: Starts in the five most recent eligible team matches.
computation: Sum starting indicators over recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Lineup/stat record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: minutes_ewma_10
description: Recency-weighted minutes across up to ten eligible appearances.
computation: Exponentially weighted mean with decay 0.35 by match recency.
availability_rule: event_time and available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: goals_last_5
description: Goals in the five most recent eligible appearances.
computation: Sum canonical goals over recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: assists_last_5
description: Assists in the five most recent eligible appearances.
computation: Sum canonical assists over recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: xg_per90_last_10
description: Expected goals per 90 across ten eligible appearances.
computation: 90 times summed xG divided by summed minutes over recency ranks 1 through 10.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: xa_per90_last_10
description: Expected assists per 90 across ten eligible appearances.
computation: 90 times summed xA divided by summed minutes over recency ranks 1 through 10.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: shots_per90_last_5
description: Shot volume per 90 across five eligible appearances.
computation: 90 times summed shots divided by summed minutes over recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: tackles_per90_last_10
description: Tackles per 90 across ten eligible appearances.
computation: 90 times summed tackles divided by summed minutes over recency ranks 1 through 10.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: interceptions_per90_last_10
description: Interceptions per 90 across ten eligible appearances.
computation: 90 times summed interceptions divided by summed minutes over recency ranks 1 through 10.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: saves_per90_last_10
description: Goalkeeper saves per 90 across ten eligible appearances.
computation: 90 times summed saves divided by summed minutes over recency ranks 1 through 10.
availability_rule: Source record available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: team_goals_for_last_5
description: Team goals across its five most recent eligible matches.
computation: Sum goals_for over team recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Match and stats available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: team_xg_for_ewma_10
description: Recency-weighted team expected goals created.
computation: Exponentially weighted mean xg_for over ten team matches.
availability_rule: Stats available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: team_xg_against_ewma_10
description: Recency-weighted team expected goals conceded.
computation: Exponentially weighted mean xg_against over ten team matches.
availability_rule: Stats available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: opponent_goals_against_last_5
description: Opponent goals conceded across five eligible matches.
computation: Sum opponent goals_against over recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Match and stats available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: opponent_xg_against_ewma_10
description: Recency-weighted opponent expected goals conceded.
computation: Exponentially weighted mean xg_against over ten opponent matches.
availability_rule: Stats available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: home_flag
description: Whether the player's club is the home team.
computation: Candidate team equals fixture home team.
availability_rule: Fixture identity must be available before prediction_cutoff.
null_strategy: Reject row when fixture identity is unknown.

name: rest_days
description: Days since the team's most recent eligible match.
computation: Difference between kickoff and latest previous team event_time.
availability_rule: Previous match available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: schedule_congestion_14d
description: Eligible team matches played in the prior fourteen days.
computation: Count previous matches with event_time within 14 days.
availability_rule: Previous match available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.
null_strategy: Zero only when schedule coverage is complete.

name: referee_cards_per_match_20
description: Regularized referee card rate over recent assignments.
computation: Mean cards over up to 20 matches, shrunk to league mean.
availability_rule: Assignments and cards available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: referee_penalties_per_match_20
description: Regularized referee penalty rate over recent assignments.
computation: Mean penalties over up to 20 matches, shrunk to league mean.
availability_rule: Assignments and events available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.

name: market_implied_team_goals
description: Team goal expectation inferred from pre-match odds.
computation: Vig-adjusted market probabilities converted to goal expectation.
availability_rule: Odds snapshot available_at must be no later than prediction_cutoff.
null_strategy: Model team-strength prior plus odds-missing indicator.

name: team_goals_against_last_5
description: Goals conceded by the team in its five latest eligible fixtures.
computation: Sum canonical goals_against over team recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Match result must be known before the prediction cutoff.
null_strategy: Zero with explicit team history count.

name: opponent_goals_for_last_5
description: Goals scored by the opponent in its five latest eligible fixtures.
computation: Sum goals_for over opponent recency ranks 1 through 5.
availability_rule: Match result must be known before the prediction cutoff.
null_strategy: Zero with explicit opponent history count.

name: player_history_count
description: Number of eligible historical player observations, capped at ten.
computation: Count eligible player rows with recency rank at most ten.
availability_rule: event_time and available_at must precede cutoff.
null_strategy: Zero indicates cold start, never a measured zero performance.

name: position_competition_minutes_share_5
description: Player share of minutes among teammates in the same position group.
computation: Player minutes divided by same-position team minutes across five matches.
availability_rule: All source rows available_at must be before prediction_cutoff.
